notes.title: Small update 0.5.4
notes.content:
List of changes:

 Shards are now also given beyond wave 100 (to give to the friendly wizard)
 You can now re-arrange items in inventory by dragging
 When a recipe is active in the tower, all the inventory slots will be green
 The items in the wizard shop now can only be bought once
 The amount of shards you receive is more variable, but buffed in the end. 
 The Archangel boss wave now end when you defeat all the enemies spawned during the wave AND by killing the boss
 Certain recipes would suppress certain stats (like Fire Storm would suppress burn from it's items), this has been removed for the stats. The effects of the items in a recipe are still suppressed (like the effect of Lit Match in Fire Storm)
 Frost Gold per Kill value is now consistent in both the in-game description and progression description
 Fixed a bug where enemies that entered your base did not get instantly killed (because enemies at very high waves had a lot of health) which resulted in them dealing more damage to the base instantly killing you.
 Fixed a bug where slow could be higher than 100%, which resulted in the enemies walking backward x)
 Fixed a bug where the drones could case an error, which resulted in more errors (happened when you switched a drone while it was shooting and that shot would kill an enemy)
 Fixed a bug where red random items would sometimes give items of lower rarity
 Fixed a placeholder text bug
 Fixed a bug where sometimes too many tree were rendered which caused an error for the dropping leaves visual effect
 Hopefully) Fixed a bug where the dutch language would show up (while it is not fully translated yet)

notes.title: Update 0.5.3
notes.content:
Fixes and changes for update 0.5.3

- The friendly wizard now will keep on providing you items for shards after wave 100!
- The critical strike damage of Head hunter now works with lightning tower scaling (and all other scaling)
- Adjusted the scaling in endless mode. Wave 1000 should be much harder to reach
- All endless enemies with the modifier Regeneration should heal now
- Changed the descriptions of some achievements where the description still said some old information
- Changed the description of the gold amulet achievement. The items have to be in the tower inventory! (that's how it worked but I but a wrong description in the achievements)
- Resolution of items in tower inventory is restored back to before previous update
- Fixed a bug where you did not get the achievement of unlocking all modifiers if you first beat two-lane hardmode, then one-lane hardmode (while having all requirements met)
- Fixed a bug where the game would freeze for seconds to minutes when unlocking either the lightning tower abilities, or the spike tower ability
- Fixed a bug where if you had too many lightning towers and used the Lightning Focus recipe, the amount of lightning strikes would be too much which resulted in an error
- Fixed a bug where an error would occur if the friendly wizard's shop would display a highest rarity item
- Fixed an issue where pressing Escape in the main menu screen would generate an error
- Fixed the naming of the items to be more consistent with the previous items (Uppercase consistency)
- Fixed a bug where the damage calculations of Damage releaser was incorrect.
- Fixed a bug which introduced some minor number inconsistencies in the post game screen

- Buffed Overpowered mace 375% -> 425%
- Buffed Damage releaser 600% -> 750%
- Nerfed Head hunter 400% -> 375%

notes.title: Small patch 0.5.2
notes.content:
Thanks for all the bug reports on both the discord and the steam forums!

Fixes and changes

 Fixed some item unlock conditions not working properly (for example the 10 lightning towers condition)
 Corrected certain achievements, now they all should show/work properly!
 No more level continue when getting defeated
 Fixed a bug where the endless popup kept showing up when loading a game in wave 50 or higher
 You can now decrease the range of a tower to 0 and in turn unlock the Sunflower item when reaching range 1
 Fixed the flamethrower tower bird causing errors
 Increased the resolution of the question mark of unrolled items

notes.title: Small patch (still called 0.5.1 by accident)
notes.content:
Some quick fixes


Made the endless scaling scale more exponential
Made some item text descriptions more clear
Golden Lootbag unlock condition should work now

notes.title: Small patch 0.5.1
notes.content:
Fixed a couple of small bugs and a buff to Motion Sensor and Location Radar


Fixed a bug where custom maps did not get to go into endless mode (an error happened when getting 1 of the new achievements, which resulted in more weird bugs like not being able to go into endless mode)
Buffed the Motion sensor and the Location radar. Also made their description more clear
Golden lootbag now works as per description

Thank you all for the bug reports!

notes.title: Big game update 0.5.0
notes.content:
Hello all!

Finally after too many months I can proudly announce a new update. The update is a bigger one than previous updates :)

Why did it take me this long? There are a couple of reasons: studies, some personal things, had to fix some garbage code to add new features (first time bigger game code and all...), scraped things after building them(they did not make sense, either based on the content or based on balancing) and because certain things took more time than I had anticipated. 

Now onto the update and what changed:

Damage numbers got a rework
The damage numbers now look better and show little icons to better understand what damage is being dealt. The damage number system is also made using a very efficient method allowing me to spawn lots and lots of damage numbers without impacting the fps much/at all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43677874/80fdb022ba1eefd13b9f59ccf10382584457b615.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43677874/e2eb2d6295522aae97cef924f7cda83b3a29c395.jpg


Tower ability changes
Certain towers had abilities that did not feel good to use(like the tornado on the rain tower). I gave these towers new abilities and hope they feel better/ feel like they have more impact.

Magical shots for the projectile tower
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43677874/a6bb972bf2b784897e82e35c4e41f040c3586adb.jpg

Made new maps with new map mechanics
Previously there was only 1 map, the green one. I decided to add more variety to the maps including different mechanics per map. I have not described these in the handbook yet (maybe never? Intentionally of course).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43677874/f28a828da60f9142123ee05c13c09f1538470464.jpg

Custom maps
Defeated the 4 new maps and want a different challenge? Custom maps! There are currently 2 custom maps available with more to come

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43677874/c222497255a558e291ff346c5e329f877ff2b5e1.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43677874/a3b7baa40bc01c70c59dc6a9b58c43ba00941057.jpg

Run modifiers
Defeated the 4 new maps AND/OR the custom maps and want a different challenge? Try the run modifiers and see if you can beat the maps on these modifiers (also try to complete the achievement related to the modifiers :) )

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43677874/51eb0715939a0a1df12b61b2fe306354732b04e0.png

VFX visibility noise settings
A much requested feature was being able to lower the amount of visual noise the visual effects created. An option has been added to the Video Options in game. You can either show all, which is default and normal, partially reduced which shows the most important ones (like the attacks of towers), or all reduced.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43677874/c0d01c42e451b6d0a3fe2f65df8cfbf71188af7f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43677874/094696f5fde7b75d7404fb44593721097665692c.jpg

New method for obtaining items
I removed the mysterious force because I did not really like it. Now instead you can trade your items in the main base to get other items. Go try it out! (you still get shards, now by killing the bosses. So the friendly wizard still sells you items).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43677874/fbc60cb94944c156c16cc1df87519b503dfcd3ef.jpg

Endless mode
The 4 maps + the custom maps now all have endless mode. After defeating wave 50 you get a prompt whether you want to end it, or keep on going in endless mode. How far can you come?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43677874/7612aac22e357ff0c937a1179013138974f6189b.jpg

UI changes
Made the UI more consistent and better looking.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43677874/63863811b122fc861133979a2c0f12c64882b06f.jpg

Added 4 new item recipes
Lightning focus, Path missile, Fire storm and Laser support

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43677874/470bade35f1ee712161406b0f6255457023a55fb.jpg

Custom targeting for certain towers
Certain towers can now be aimed manually at a certain location.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43677874/774469b98b3983aa5d413247820424c002c258a1.jpg

and some less screenshot-able changes


 10 new achievements
 New and fresh leader boards
 Added 30+ new items with a new item tier (also retired and reintroduced some items)
 Lots of balancing changes to both items and towers
 Lots of bugs fixed (and I probably introduced some new bugs as well which I will work hard on the next couple days/weeks to fix!)
 Lots of optimization updates. The game should run smoother for most people now!


Future of updates
In the coming days/weeks I will be mostly working on the bugs that people will find, some balancing and some QOL changes.
After that I will be working on the 1.0 update. 
I have a bunch of ideas for towers, items, progression, and an additional map.
I've been working on additional language support which will be finished for the 1.0
And of course I will be reading some of the suggestions you guys make :)

Bug reports
If you find bugs or weird things, please do tell me! I will try to fix them asap. You can either message me on discord (you can place it in the server or dm me/@ me) or fill in the bug form which you can find a link to in the game main menu.
I also made a new entry on the steam forum where you can submit it

End note
I want to say sorry for not responding too much on the steam forums/discord. As time went on I found it difficult to respond to people because I couldn't really show/announce new things that I had been working on (because progression was slow by the aforementioned reasons). Thank you all for the nice words, support and reviews. They do really help me with the development of the game :)

notes.title: Update 0.1.5
notes.content:
I took a break the past week and finally have the following update that addressed hopefully most of the bugs that you all encountered :). Also a small tweak to boulder damage and fire money earning. Will post another update in a week that will contain more bigger changes!

- Fixed a bug where you could level a tower cheaply by using a tower without a crystal. Thanks for the user reporting this bug!
- Fixed a bug where the wizard appear text appeared in the bottom left of the screen
- Fixed a bug where the burn of towers would not credit them with the kills the burn made
- Fixed a bug where inventory slots where not visible when saving and loading the game
- Fixed the visual bug of the Meteor item
- Fixed various bugs that could cause an error which would result in a bunch of other errors (like incorrect stats in end screen, no leaderboard entries etc.)

- Added two buttons to the tower inventory, 1 to sort the inventory and 1 to move all items to the main inventory
- Wizard shop can't be re-rolled when saving and loading the game
- The strange force shouldn't take your items without giving shard in return when saving and loading the game
- Stones in the sea will now stay consistent when saving and loading the game
- Timer will now also show times from over 1 hour

- Changed the item Enchanced attack from every 6 seconds 1 attack deals more damage to every 6 seconds deal more damage for 1 second
- Made the visual of Chain lightning item more visible
- Added sound to the explosive missile
- Right clicking twice in a row closes all open inventories and shops
- Made a bunch of performance enhancing changes.
- You can now use the escape key in all sections in the main menu to go back to the main menu 
- Made the boss fight with the King skeleton summoner a bit brighter to see what is going on
- Made the water-beam and upgraded arcane nova transparent
- The wizard won't take your shard anymore if you do not have any inventory space
- Missiles from missile drones now also get enhanced by the Missile enhancer

Re-balanced earth crystal progression tree:
	EarthDamage 40% -> 15%
	EarthArmorDamage 15% -> 5%
	EarthRange 2 -> 1

Buffed Fire Generate Money 1% -> 5%

notes.title: Update 0.1.4
notes.content:
- Made an optimization to make the map load faster (so starting and restarting should be a bit faster), this is also a stepping stone for implementing endless mode
- Added new cursor colors so you do not lose them anymore in intense situations :)
- Added the option to disable disable water reflection (This one will improve FPS a decent bit!)
- On larger screens the reset all text will not be super small anymore
- UI scale will not reset to 100% anymore when starting up the game
- When putting speed mode on speed 4, it will remember last mode and fall back to that one when an enemy gets damaged

New cursor colors:

notes.title: Update 0.1.3
notes.content:
- Fixed issue with two-lane hardmode not working as intended. You can now properly play two-lane hardmode
- Fixed issue with attack speed going above max
